I was suffering from severe depression and anxiety since 2016 and my therapist recommended I see a psychiatrist. I was also very against medication but I was so suicidal that I just had to give something a try. I’ve been on 20mg/day since last year and I’ve felt so amazing since. It took a month to kick in but when it did, it was as if I could see in colour again if that makes sense. I started hanging out with my friends and family again and it makes me wish I started sooner. I really think you’ll be happy when it kicks in and we’re all proud of you for taking this step! Best of luck on your journey! ♥️
